id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying snowflake resource monitor quota errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a terminal error classification and regression test for Snowflake warehouse resource-monitor-quota exhaustion, preventing unnecessary retry loops and allowing customers to address quota issues before resuming warehouse ingestion.
review.reason: Adds a new non-retryable error pattern and its user-facing message, and adds a parametrized test asserting that this specific Snowflake resource-monitor-quota error is classified as non-retryable.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion workflow not already handling this specific error; the score assumes this is a substantive addition rather than a minor edge-case fix. No test of actual warehouse behavior or production incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error pattern and its user-facing message, and adds a parametrized test asserting that this specific Snowflake resource-monitor-quota error is classified as non-retryable.
observations.code_quote: "cannot be resumed because resource monitor": "Your Snowflake warehouse can't resume because its resource monitor has used its credit quota. Raise the quota or wait for it to reset, then resync.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change expands the set of Snowflake warehouse ingestion errors that PostHog treats as terminal rather than recoverable. When a warehouse cannot resume due to resource monitor quota exhaustion, PostHog will not retry the warehouse connection, preventing an infinite retry loop and allowing the customer to address the quota issue before resync.
